$description: Mora bot characters v4: the arch family. Geometry is in SVG path syntax on a 40 x 40 unit canvas. The same strings work as Android VectorDrawable pathData and WinUI/XAML Path data; SwiftUI and Compose parse them with any SVG path parser. See docs/BRAND.md section 6.

eyes.$description: Each glyph is drawn once per eye, centered on (cx, cy) = (14.5, 22.5) and (25.5, 22.5). Paths below are for the left eye; translate by +11 on x for the right eye.

flip.use: blocked (rotate left eye +14 deg and right eye -14 deg around each eye center)

colors.$description: OKLCH with near-equal lightness so no bot looks more important. No hue within 45 degrees of the working purple (293). Paused = same lightness at 15% chroma.

thinking.motion: eyes drift between (1.2,-1.4) and (-1.2,-1.4), 2.4 s alternate

working.motion: body nods 1.2 u every 0.8 s; eyes scan +/-1.2 u over 1.6 s

waiting.motion: one 3.2 u hop every 3.2 s; blink every 4 s

blocked.motion: three +/-1 u shakes in 400 ms, every 3 s

done.motion: one bounce (480 ms), hold 4 s, then idle

paused.motion: none; body uses the paused color

transitions.acknowledge: one 3.2 u hop, 320 ms, when the bot receives a mention or a task

reducedMotion: No loops, hops, shakes or bounces. Eye glyphs and offsets still change, so every state stays visible without motion.

sizes.16: Mention chip. Static idle face only.
sizes.20: Author line in group chats. Static idle face only.

assignment.hash: FNV-1a 32-bit over the UTF-8 bytes of the NFC-normalized bot id
assignment.combinations: 5 silhouettes x 8 colors = 40; index i maps to silhouette = assignableSilhouettes[i % 5], color = colors[floor(i / 5)]
assignment.order: start = hash % 40; walk i = (start + k * 17) % 40 for k = 0..39 (17 is coprime with 40, so every pair is visited once)
assignment.rule: Walk the order and take the first look whose silhouette and color are both unused in the workspace; if none, the first with an unused color; if none, the first unused pair; past 40 bots, the first in the order. So the first five bots get five silhouettes, the first eight get eight colors, and no two bots share a look until there are 40. Store { silhouette, color } on the bot and never recompute it; renaming a bot keeps its look. People can change it in bot settings.
